request: Pull DoD contract awards (agency 'Department of Defense', top-tier) from USAspending.gov for the current fiscal year (2025-10-01 through today, 2026-07-14), enrich with NAICS flattening, days_of_performance, and trend analysis by Awarding Sub Agency + Recipient. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 11 - DoD Contract Awards' on Tableau Server for defense procurement analysts.

sources.name: USAspending DoD Awards FY2026
sources.description: USAspending.gov spending_by_award API, filtered to Department of Defense as the top-tier awarding agency, FY2026 (2025-10-01 through 2026-07-14). Award type codes A/B/C/D (BPA Calls, Purchase Orders, Delivery Orders, Definitive Contracts). Public, keyless. POST + JSON body; pagination uses 'page' in body with page_metadata.hasNext cursor termination.

args.name: DoD Award Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from Start Date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of DoD contract award rows.
args.stats_description: Long-form DoD contract award statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over Awarding Sub Agency and Recipient Name). Includes monthly_count, 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify sub-agencies with surging award volume or unusual vendor concentration.

outputs.name: DoD Award Detail
outputs.description: Row-level DoD contract awards from USAspending.gov for FY2026 (2025-10-01 through 2026-07-14). Includes Award ID, Recipient Name, Awarding Agency, Awarding Sub Agency (Army/Navy/AF/DLA/etc.), Award Amount (USD), Start/End dates, Description, naics_code + naics_description (flattened from the API's nested NAICS object), days_of_performance (End - Start), Place of Performance State Code. Plus calendar features (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Source: api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award with agency filter type=awarding, tier=toptier, name='Department of Defense'. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: DoD Award Stats
outputs.description: Long-form DoD contract award statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over Awarding Sub Agency and Recipient Name). Includes 30-day rolling counts, YoY deltas + pct change (limited use here since demo window is <12 months), z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to spot sub-agencies surging in award volume, or vendors gaining unusual concentration. Source: USAspending.gov.
